name: artcraft-design-toolkit
description: On-demand CLI and MCP gateway for seven ArtCraft creative apps, with one focused skill.

interface.shortDescription: Use ArtCraft apps from Codex when a craft task calls for them
interface.longDescription: Choose the relevant ArtCraft app, run its allowlisted CLI commands, or open its native MCP session through one on-demand gateway. Keeps the seven native servers off until selected for a task.
